summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style hex-identifier JavaScript that downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts the platform-specific bun binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily-obfuscated blob (rotating string-array indexing, hex-named globals, encoded operand tables) shipped at the tarball root. The package advertises itself as an ESLint configuration; neither the README nor index.js references math_init.js or Bun, and an ESLint config has no legitimate need for a second language runtime at install time. The preinstall lifecycle hook fires automatically on npm install, executing the obfuscated Bun payload before any Node-based scanner or sandbox inspects it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
